title: Microsoft Tech-Support Scam
caller: claims to be Microsoft technical support

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hello, I'm calling from Microsoft technical support. Our servers detected a serious virus on your computer.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: A virus? I didn't report anything.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: It's a critical threat — hackers are stealing your banking details right now. We must act immediately before they drain your account.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: I need you to download a program so I can remote in and fix it. Do not turn off your computer.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Yes sir. To cover the security license, you'll need to pay $299 — and the only way our system accepts is with Apple gift cards. Go to the store now and read me the codes.
